# Recruitment
## Column

### Column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| label: overall recruitment 
#| title: Overall Recruitment 
#| echo: false
#| warning: false 
#| fig.height: 15
#| fig-width: 12

options(datatable.IDateTime.classes = c("Date", "POSIXct"))
dat <- fread("data/subject_summary.csv", header = T)
acc <- accrual_create_df(dat$enrollment_date, by = dat$city)
p1 <- gg_accrual_plot_cum(acc$Overall) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  scale_x_date(labels = function(x) format(x, format = "%d %b %Y"))
p2 <- gg_accrual_plot_abs(acc$Overall, unit = "month") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  scale_x_date(labels = function(x) format(x, format = "%b %Y"))
grid.arrange(nrow=2, ncol=1, p1,p2)

```


```{r}
#| label: Recruitment per site
#| title: Recruitment per Site
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig.height: 17
#| fig-width: 15
cols <- c(unibeIceS(), unibeApricotS(), unibeSaphireS(),unibeMintS(),unibeRed(),unibeBlack())

p1 <- gg_accrual_plot_cum(acc[names(acc) != "Overall"]) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  scale_x_date(labels = function(x) format(x, format = "%d %b %Y")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
  theme(legend.position = "left") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)))
p2 <- plot(acc, which = "abs", unit = "month", engine = "gg") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  scale_x_date(labels = function(x) format(x, format = "%b %Y")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  theme(legend.position = "left")
grid.arrange(nrow=2, ncol=1, p1,p2)

```

```{r}
report_table$Center <- as.factor(report_table$Center)

kable(

) %>%
```

# Safety 

## Column

### Row 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: General information
#| title: General information


sae_df <- fread("data/sae.csv", header = T)
n_patient_sae <- sae_df %>% distinct(record_id) %>% nrow()
n_patient <- dat %>% distinct(record_id) %>% nrow()
pc_sae <- (n_patient_sae/n_patient)*100
pc_sae <- round(pc_sae)

```

So far `r n_patient_sae` patients had at least one SAE since the start of the study. This represents `r pc_sae`% of patients.


#### column {.tabset} 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center
#| label: SAE by country
#| title: SAE by country
# Count patients with ≥1 SAE per country
sae_country_summary <- sae_df %>%
  distinct(record_id, country) %>%              # Each patient counted once per country
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(n_with_SAE = n()) %>%
  left_join(
    dat %>%
      group_by(country) %>%
      summarise(n_patients = n()),              # Total patients per country
    by = "country"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_with_SAE = round((n_with_SAE / n_patients) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_with_SAE))

# Display nicely formatted table
kable(
  format = "html",
  sae_country_summary,
  caption = "Patients with ≥1 SAE per Country",
  col.names = c(
    "Country",
    "Patients <br> with ≥1 SAE",  # line break here
    "Total <br> Patients",
    "% <br> with SAE"
  ),
  escape = FALSE   # important to allow <br> in headers
) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
```

### column {.tabset}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-height: 11
#| fig-width: 10
#| label: SAE rate by site
#| title: SAE rate by site
sae_city_rate <- sae_df %>%
  distinct(record_id, city, country) %>%              # Each patient counted once
  group_by(country, city) %>%
  summarise(n_patients_with_SAE = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    dat %>%
      group_by(country, city) %>%
      summarise(n_patients = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("country", "city")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_with_SAE = round((n_patients_with_SAE / n_patients) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_with_SAE))%>% 
  mutate(pct_with_SAE = case_when(city == "Baden" ~ 0,
                           TRUE ~ pct_with_SAE))


# --- Bar plot (% of patients with ≥1 SAE per city) ---
ggplot(sae_city_rate, aes(x = reorder(city, pct_with_SAE), y = pct_with_SAE, fill = country)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(pct_with_SAE == 0, "", paste0(pct_with_SAE, "%"))),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "% of Patients with ≥1 SAE per City",
    x = "City",
    y = "% of Patients with SAE",
    fill = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(unibeIce(),unibeApricot(), unibeGreen(),unibeMint()))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-height: 11
#| fig-width: 10
#| label: SAEs over time
#| title: SAEs over time

sae_time <- sae_df %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(event_onset_date, "month")) %>%
  count(month, event_name)

# Ensure month is Date
sae_time <- sae_time %>% mutate(month = as.Date(month))

# Define line and marker colors per event
event_names <- unique(sae_time$event_name)
line_colors <- c(unibeRed(), unibeMustard(), unibeApricot(), unibeGreen(), unibeMintS())
names(line_colors) <- event_names
marker_colors <- c(unibeRed(), unibeMustard(), unibeApricot(), unibeGreen(), unibeMintS())
names(marker_colors) <- event_names

# Initialize Plotly figure
p <- plot_ly()

# Add a trace per event
for(ev in event_names) {
  df <- sae_time %>% filter(event_name == ev)
  
  p <- p %>% add_trace(
    data = df,
    x = ~month,
    y = ~n,
    type = 'scatter',
    mode = 'lines+markers',
    name = ev,
    line = list(color = line_colors[ev], width = 2),
    marker = list(color = marker_colors[ev], size = 8),
    text = ~paste("Event:", event_name,
                  "<br>Month:", format(month, "%b %Y"),
                  "<br>Count:", n),
    hoverinfo = 'text',
    visible = TRUE  # initially all visible; dropdown will toggle
  )
}

# Create dropdown buttons
buttons <- lapply(seq_along(event_names), function(i) {
  visibility <- rep(FALSE, length(event_names))
  visibility[i] <- TRUE
  list(method = "restyle",
       args = list("visible", visibility),
       label = event_names[i])
})

# Add a "Show All" button
buttons <- c(list(list(method = "restyle",
                       args = list("visible", rep(TRUE, length(event_names))),
                       label = "Show All")), buttons)

p <- p %>% layout(
  title = "SAEs Over Time",
  height = 700,
  width = 900,
  
  # Axes
  xaxis = list(
    title = "Time",
    type = "date",
    tickformat = "%b %Y",
    tickangle = -45
  ),
  yaxis = list(title = "Number of Events"),
  
  # Legend BELOW the x-axis
  legend = list(
    orientation = "h",     # horizontal legend
    x = 0.5,               # center it
    y = -0.25,             # move it below the plot
    xanchor = "center",
    yanchor = "top",
    bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0)",  # transparent background
    traceorder = "normal"
  ),
  
  # Dropdown menu above the plot, outside plotting area
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      y = 1.15,         # above plot
      x = 0,            # left side
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = buttons
    )
  ),
  
  # Margins to give space for dropdown and legend
  margin = list(
    t = 120,   # top margin for dropdown
    l = 80,    # left margin for y-axis
    r = 50,    # right margin
    b = 100    # bottom margin for x-axis labels
  )
)

p


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-height: 15
#| fig-width: 15
#| label: Patient retention curve
#| title: Patient retention curve


retention_data <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    time_days = study_duration_days,
    event = if_else(dropout, 1, 0),   # 1 = dropped out, 0 = censored (completed)
    country = factor(country)
  )

# --- Fit survival curve (retention = 1 - dropout) ---
fit_retention <- survfit(Surv(time_days, event) ~ country, data = retention_data)

# --- Plot survival (retention) curve ---
ggsurvplot(
  fit_retention,
  data = retention_data,
  conf.int = F,
  censor = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  surv.median.line = "hv",
  palette = c(unibeIce(),unibeApricot(), unibeGreen(),unibeMint()),
  ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 20),
  title = "Patient Retention Over Time (Kaplan–Meier Style)",
  xlab = "Days Since Enrollment",
  ylab = "Proportion of Patients Remaining",
  legend.title = "Country",
  legend.labs = c("France", "Germany", "Italy", "Switzerland"),
  break.time.by = 200  # sets x-axis breaks every 200 days
) 

```

# Data Quality 

## column

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: Missing data per form, visit and site
#| title: Missing data per form, visit and site


missing_df <- fread("data/missing_df.csv")

#Aggregate average missing rate per site × form × visit

heatmap_df_3d <- missing_df %>%
group_by(site_id, form, visit_name) %>%
summarise(avg_missing = mean(n_missing / n_fields), .groups = "drop")

visits <- c("Screening", "Enrollment", "Visit_1", "Visit_2", 
            "Visit_3", "Visit_4", "Safety_Followup")

#Start empty plotly object

p <- plot_ly()

#Add a heatmap for each visit

for (i in seq_along(visits)) {
v <- visits[i]
df_v <- heatmap_df_3d %>% filter(visit_name == v)

mat <- df_v %>%
select(-visit_name) %>% # remove visit_name column
pivot_wider(names_from = form, values_from = avg_missing) %>%
column_to_rownames(var = "site_id") %>%
as.matrix()

p <- p %>%
add_trace(
z = mat,
x = colnames(mat),
y = rownames(mat),
type = "heatmap",
colorscale = list(c(0,1), c("white", unibeRed())),
visible = ifelse(i == 1, TRUE, FALSE),
name = v,
hovertemplate = "Site: %{y}Form: %{x}Avg Missing: %{z:.1%}"
)
}

#Build dropdown buttons

buttons <- lapply(seq_along(visits), function(i) {
list(
label = visits[i],
method = "update",
args = list(
list(visible = sapply(seq_along(visits), function(j) j == i)),
list(title = paste("Average Missing Data -", visits[i]))
)
)
})

#Layout: center title, give extra top margin, and place dropdown below the plot

p <- p %>%
layout(
title = list(
text = paste("Average Missing Data -", visits[1]),
x = 0.5,
xanchor = "center",
font = list(size = 16)
),
xaxis = list(title = "Form", tickangle = -45, automargin = TRUE),
yaxis = list(title = "Site", automargin = TRUE),
width = 700,
height = 800,
margin = list(l = 120, r = 40, t = 120, b = 120), # larger top & left margins
updatemenus = list(
list(
type = "dropdown",
direction = "down",
showactive = TRUE,
active = 0,
x = 1.02,          # slightly to the right of the plot area
xanchor = "left",  # anchor the dropdown to its left edge
y = 0.5,           # vertically centered on the plot
yanchor = "middle",
pad = list(t = 10),
buttons = buttons
)
)
)

# Center the plot in the chunk (HTML widget)
p <- htmltools::tags$div(
  style = "display:flex; justify-content:center; width:100%;",
  p
)

#Print the widget
p

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
```
